The '''history of podracing exhibition''' was an exhibition held in a mezzanine room above a race viewing gallery on the second floor of the [[Concessions concourses/Legends|concessions concourses]] in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]], a venue used for [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The exhibition covered the history of podracing, a sport in involving the use of [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]], and the exhibition included several of the vehicles on display. During the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace<ref name="Inside" /> held in [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> several individuals viewed the exhibition.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
The history of podracing exhibition was first mentioned the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Inside" />
